attachment.content:
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

17	## Features
18	
19	- **Instant Capture** — Timeline-first UI. Open, write, done — no folders to navigate.
20	- **Total Data Ownership** — Self-hosted on your infrastructure. Notes stored in Markdown, always portable. Zero telemetry.
21	- **Radical Simplicity** — Single Go binary, ~20MB Docker image. One command to deploy with SQLite, MySQL, or PostgreSQL.
22	- **Open & Extensible** — MIT-licensed with full REST and gRPC APIs for integration.

21	// Migration System Overview:
22	//
23	// The migration system handles database schema versioning and upgrades.
24	// Schema version is stored in system_setting.
25	//
26	// Migration Flow:
27	// 1. preMigrate: Check if DB is initialized. If not, apply LATEST.sql
28	// 2. checkMinimumUpgradeVersion: Verify installation can be upgraded (reject pre-0.22 installations)
29	// 3. Migrate (prod mode): Apply incremental migrations from current to target version
30	// 4. Migrate (demo mode): Seed database with demo data
31	// Deployment configuration is loaded separately after migration completes.
32	//
33	// Version Tracking:
34	// - New installations: Schema version set in system_setting immediately
35	// - Existing v0.22+ installations: Schema version tracked in system_setting
36	// - Pre-v0.22 installations: Must upgrade to v0.25.x first (migration_history → system_setting migration)
37	//
38	// Migration Files:
39	// - Location: store/migration/{driver}/{version}/NN__description.sql
40	// - Naming: NN is zero-padded patch number, description is human-readable
41	// - Ordering: Files sorted lexicographically and applied in order
42	// - LATEST.sql: Full schema for new installations (faster than incremental migrations)
43	
44	//go:embed migration
45	var migrationFS embed.FS
46	
47	//go:embed seed
48	var seedFS embed.FS
49	
50	const (
51		// MigrateFileNameSplit is the split character between the patch version and the description in the migration file name.
52		// For example, "1__create_table.sql".
53		MigrateFileNameSplit = "__"
54		// LatestSchemaFileName is the name of the latest schema file.
55		// This file is used to initialize fresh installations with the current schema.
56		LatestSchemaFileName = "LATEST.sql"
57	
58		// defaultSchemaVersion is used when schema version is empty or not set.
59		// This handles edge cases for old installations without version tracking.
60		defaultSchemaVersion = "0.0.0"
61	)

63	// getSchemaVersionOrDefault returns the schema version or default if empty.
64	// This ensures safe version comparisons and handles old installations.
65	func getSchemaVersionOrDefault(schemaVersion string) string {
66		if schemaVersion == "" {
67			return defaultSchemaVersion
68		}
69		return schemaVersion
70	}
71	
72	// isVersionEmpty checks if the schema version is empty or the default value.
73	func isVersionEmpty(schemaVersion string) bool {
74		return schemaVersion == "" || schemaVersion == defaultSchemaVersion
75	}
76	
77	// shouldApplyMigration determines if a migration file should be applied.
78	// It checks if the file's version is between the current DB version and target version.
79	func shouldApplyMigration(fileVersion, currentDBVersion, targetVersion string) bool {
80		currentDBVersionSafe := getSchemaVersionOrDefault(currentDBVersion)
81		return version.IsVersionGreaterThan(fileVersion, currentDBVersionSafe) &&
82			version.IsVersionGreaterOrEqualThan(targetVersion, fileVersion)
83	}
84	
85	// validateMigrationFileName checks if a migration file follows the expected naming convention.
86	// Expected format: "NN__description.sql" where NN is a zero-padded number.
87	func validateMigrationFileName(filename string) error {
88		parts := strings.SplitN(filename, MigrateFileNameSplit, 2)
89		if len(parts) < 2 {
90			return errors.Errorf("invalid migration filename format (missing %s): %s", MigrateFileNameSplit, filename)
91		}
92		if _, err := strconv.Atoi(parts[0]); err != nil {
93			return errors.Errorf("migration filename must start with a number: %s", filename)
94		}
95		return nil
96	}

98	// Migrate migrates the database schema to the latest version.
99	// It checks the current schema version and applies any necessary migrations.
100	// It also seeds the database with initial data if in demo mode.
101	func (s *Store) Migrate(ctx context.Context) error {
102		if err := s.preMigrate(ctx); err != nil {
103			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to pre-migrate")
104		}
105	
106		instanceBasicSetting, err := s.GetInstanceBasicSetting(ctx)
107		if err != nil {
108			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get instance basic setting")
109		}
110		currentSchemaVersion, err := s.GetCurrentSchemaVersion()
111		if err != nil {
112			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get current schema version")
113		}
114		// Check for downgrade (but skip if schema version is empty - that means fresh/old installation)
115		if !isVersionEmpty(instanceBasicSetting.SchemaVersion) && version.IsVersionGreaterThan(instanceBasicSetting.SchemaVersion, currentSchemaVersion) {
116			slog.Error("cannot downgrade schema version",
117				slog.String("databaseVersion", instanceBasicSetting.SchemaVersion),
118				slog.String("currentVersion", currentSchemaVersion),
119			)
120			return errors.Errorf("cannot downgrade schema version from %s to %s", instanceBasicSetting.SchemaVersion, currentSchemaVersion)
121		}
122		// Apply migrations if needed.
123		if isVersionEmpty(instanceBasicSetting.SchemaVersion) || version.IsVersionGreaterThan(currentSchemaVersion, instanceBasicSetting.SchemaVersion) {
124			if err := s.applyMigrations(ctx, instanceBasicSetting.SchemaVersion, currentSchemaVersion); err != nil {
125				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to apply migrations")
126			}
127		}
128	
129		if s.profile.Demo {
130			// In demo mode, we should seed the database.
131			if err := s.seed(ctx); err != nil {
132				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to seed")
133			}
134		}
135		return nil
136	}

138	// applyMigrations applies all necessary migration files between current and target schema versions.
139	// It runs all migrations in a single transaction for atomicity.
140	func (s *Store) applyMigrations(ctx context.Context, currentSchemaVersion, targetSchemaVersion string) error {
141		filePaths, err := fs.Glob(migrationFS, fmt.Sprintf("%s*/*.sql", s.getMigrationBasePath()))
142		if err != nil {
143			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read migration files")
144		}
145		slices.Sort(filePaths)
146	
147		// Start a transaction to apply migrations atomically
148		tx, err := s.driver.GetDB().Begin()
149		if err != nil {
150			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to start transaction")
151		}
152		defer tx.Rollback()
153	
154		// Use safe version for comparison (handles empty version case)
155		schemaVersionForComparison := getSchemaVersionOrDefault(currentSchemaVersion)
156		if isVersionEmpty(currentSchemaVersion) {
157			slog.Warn("schema version is empty, treating as default for migration comparison",
158				slog.String("defaultVersion", defaultSchemaVersion))
159		}
160	
161		slog.Info("start migration",
162			slog.String("currentSchemaVersion", schemaVersionForComparison),
163			slog.String("targetSchemaVersion", targetSchemaVersion))
164	
165		migrationsApplied := 0
166		for _, filePath := range filePaths {
167			fileSchemaVersion, err := s.getSchemaVersionOfMigrateScript(filePath)
168			if err != nil {
169				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get schema version of migrate script")
170			}
171	
172			if shouldApplyMigration(fileSchemaVersion, currentSchemaVersion, targetSchemaVersion) {
173				// Validate migration filename before applying
174				filename := filepath.Base(filePath)
175				if err := validateMigrationFileName(filename); err != nil {
176					slog.Warn("migration file has invalid name but will be applied", slog.String("file", filePath), slog.String("error", err.Error()))
177				}
178	
179				slog.Info("applying migration",
180					slog.String("file", filePath),
181					slog.String("version", fileSchemaVersion))
182	
183				bytes, err := migrationFS.ReadFile(filePath)
184				if err != nil {
185					return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to read migration file: %s", filePath)
186				}
187	
188				stmt := string(bytes)
189				if err := s.execute(ctx, tx, stmt); err != nil {
190					return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to execute migration %s: %s", filePath, err)
191				}
192				migrationsApplied++
193			}
194		}
195	
196		if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
197			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to commit migration transaction")
198		}
199	
200		slog.Info("migration completed", slog.Int("migrationsApplied", migrationsApplied))
201	
202		// Update schema version after successful migration
203		if err := s.updateCurrentSchemaVersion(ctx, targetSchemaVersion); err != nil {
204			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to update current schema version")
205		}
206	
207		return nil
208	}

210	// preMigrate checks if the database is initialized and applies the latest schema if not.
211	func (s *Store) preMigrate(ctx context.Context) error {
212		initialized, err := s.driver.IsInitialized(ctx)
213		if err != nil {
214			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to check if database is initialized")
215		}
216	
217		if !initialized {
218			filePath := s.getMigrationBasePath() + LatestSchemaFileName
219			bytes, err := migrationFS.ReadFile(filePath)
220			if err != nil {
221				return errors.Errorf("failed to read latest schema file: %s", err)
222			}
223			// Start a transaction to apply the latest schema.
224			tx, err := s.driver.GetDB().Begin()
225			if err != nil {
226				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to start transaction")
227			}
228			defer tx.Rollback()
229			slog.Info("initializing new database with latest schema", slog.String("file", filePath))
230			if err := s.execute(ctx, tx, string(bytes)); err != nil {
231				return errors.Errorf("failed to execute SQL file %s, err %s", filePath, err)
232			}
233			if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
234				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to commit transaction")
235			}
236	
237			// Upsert current schema version to database.
238			schemaVersion, err := s.GetCurrentSchemaVersion()
239			if err != nil {
240				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get current schema version")
241			}
242			slog.Info("database initialized successfully", slog.String("schemaVersion", schemaVersion))
243			if err := s.updateCurrentSchemaVersion(ctx, schemaVersion); err != nil {
244				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to update current schema version")
245			}
246		}
247	
248		if err := s.checkMinimumUpgradeVersion(ctx); err != nil {
249			return err // Error message is already descriptive, don't wrap it
250		}
251		return nil
252	}

262	// seed seeds the database with initial data.
263	// It reads all seed files from the embedded filesystem and executes them in order.
264	// This is only supported for SQLite databases and is used in demo mode.
265	func (s *Store) seed(ctx context.Context) error {
266		// Only seed for SQLite - other databases should use production data
267		if s.profile.Driver != "sqlite" {
268			slog.Warn("seed is only supported for SQLite, skipping for other databases")
269			return nil
270		}
271	
272		filenames, err := fs.Glob(seedFS, fmt.Sprintf("%s*.sql", s.getSeedBasePath()))
273		if err != nil {
274			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read seed files")
275		}
276	
277		// Sort seed files by name. This is important to ensure that seed files are applied in order.
278		slices.Sort(filenames)
279		// Start a transaction to apply the seed files.
280		tx, err := s.driver.GetDB().Begin()
281		if err != nil {
282			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to start transaction")
283		}
284		defer tx.Rollback()
285		// Loop over all seed files and execute them in order.
286		for _, filename := range filenames {
287			bytes, err := seedFS.ReadFile(filename)
288			if err != nil {
289				return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to read seed file, filename=%s", filename)
290			}
291			if err := s.execute(ctx, tx, string(bytes)); err != nil {
292				return errors.Wrapf(err, "seed error: %s", filename)
293			}
294		}
295		return tx.Commit()
296	}

298	// GetCurrentSchemaVersion returns the latest schema version available for the configured database driver.
299	func (s *Store) GetCurrentSchemaVersion() (string, error) {
300		filePaths, err := fs.Glob(migrationFS, fmt.Sprintf("%s*/*.sql", s.getMigrationBasePath()))
301		if err != nil {
302			return "", errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read migration files")
303		}
304		if len(filePaths) == 0 {
305			return defaultSchemaVersion, nil
306		}
307	
308		currentSchemaVersion := defaultSchemaVersion
309		for _, filePath := range filePaths {
310			fileSchemaVersion, err := s.getSchemaVersionOfMigrateScript(filePath)
311			if err != nil {
312				return "", errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get schema version of migrate script")
313			}
314			if version.IsVersionGreaterThan(fileSchemaVersion, currentSchemaVersion) {
315				currentSchemaVersion = fileSchemaVersion
316			}
317		}
318		return currentSchemaVersion, nil
319	}

321	// getSchemaVersionOfMigrateScript extracts the schema version from the migration script file path.
322	// It returns the schema version in the format "major.minor.patch".
323	// If the file is the latest schema file, it returns the current schema version.
324	func (s *Store) getSchemaVersionOfMigrateScript(filePath string) (string, error) {
325		// If the file is the latest schema file, return the current schema version.
326		if strings.HasSuffix(filePath, LatestSchemaFileName) {
327			return s.GetCurrentSchemaVersion()
328		}
329	
330		normalizedPath := filepath.ToSlash(filePath)
331		elements := strings.Split(normalizedPath, "/")
332		if len(elements) < 2 {
333			return "", errors.Errorf("invalid file path: %s", filePath)
334		}
335		minorVersion := elements[len(elements)-2]
336		rawPatchVersion := strings.Split(elements[len(elements)-1], MigrateFileNameSplit)[0]
337		patchVersion, err := strconv.Atoi(rawPatchVersion)
338		if err != nil {
339			return "", errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to convert patch version to int: %s", rawPatchVersion)
340		}
341		return fmt.Sprintf("%s.%d", minorVersion, patchVersion+1), nil
342	}

345	// It returns an error if the execution fails.
346	func (*Store) execute(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, stmt string) error {
347		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, stmt); err != nil {
348			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to execute statement")
349		}
350		return nil

353	// updateCurrentSchemaVersion updates the current schema version in the instance basic setting.
354	// It retrieves the instance basic setting, updates the schema version, and upserts the setting back to the database.
355	func (s *Store) updateCurrentSchemaVersion(ctx context.Context, schemaVersion string) error {
356		instanceBasicSetting, err := s.GetInstanceBasicSetting(ctx)
357		if err != nil {
358			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get instance basic setting")
359		}
360		instanceBasicSetting.SchemaVersion = schemaVersion
361		if _, err := s.UpsertInstanceSetting(ctx, &storepb.InstanceSetting{
362			Key:   storepb.InstanceSettingKey_BASIC,
363			Value: &storepb.InstanceSetting_BasicSetting{BasicSetting: instanceBasicSetting},
364		}); err != nil {
365			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to upsert instance setting")
366		}
367		return nil
368	}

370	// checkMinimumUpgradeVersion verifies the installation meets minimum version requirements for upgrade.
371	// For very old installations (< v0.22.0), users must upgrade to v0.25.x first before upgrading to current version.
372	// This is necessary because schema version tracking was moved from migration_history to system_setting in v0.22.0.
373	func (s *Store) checkMinimumUpgradeVersion(ctx context.Context) error {
374		instanceBasicSetting, err := s.GetInstanceBasicSetting(ctx)
375		if err != nil {
376			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get instance basic setting")
377		}
378		schemaVersion := instanceBasicSetting.SchemaVersion
379	
380		// Modern installation: nothing to check.
381		if !isVersionEmpty(schemaVersion) && version.IsVersionGreaterOrEqualThan(schemaVersion, "0.22.0") {
382			return nil
383		}
384	
385		// Schema version is empty for fresh installs too, but preMigrate sets it before we get here.
386		// So empty schema version on an initialized DB means a pre-v0.22 legacy installation.
387		if isVersionEmpty(schemaVersion) {
388			initialized, err := s.driver.IsInitialized(ctx)
389			if err != nil {
390				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to check if database is initialized")
391			}
392			if !initialized {
393				return nil
394			}
395		}
396	
397		// schemaVersion is either set but < 0.22.0, or empty on an initialized (legacy) DB.
398		currentVersion, _ := s.GetCurrentSchemaVersion()
399		return errors.Errorf(
400			"Your Memos installation is too old to upgrade directly.\n\n"+
401				"Your current version: %s\n"+
402				"Target version: %s\n"+
403				"Minimum required: v0.22.0 (May 2024)\n\n"+
404				"Upgrade path:\n"+
405				"1. First upgrade to v0.25.3: https://github.com/usememos/memos/releases/tag/v0.25.3\n"+
406				"2. Start the server and verify it works\n"+
407				"3. Then upgrade to the latest version\n\n"+
408				"This is required because schema version tracking was moved from migration_history\n"+
409				"to system_setting in v0.22.0. The intermediate upgrade handles this migration safely.",
410			schemaVersion,
411			currentVersion,
412		)
413	}

21	// Migration System Overview:
22	//
23	// The migration system handles database schema versioning and upgrades.
24	// Schema version is stored in system_setting.
25	//
26	// Migration Flow:
27	// 1. preMigrate: Check if DB is initialized. If not, apply LATEST.sql
28	// 2. checkMinimumUpgradeVersion: Verify installation can be upgraded (reject pre-0.22 installations)
29	// 3. Migrate (prod mode): Apply incremental migrations from current to target version
30	// 4. Migrate (demo mode): Seed database with demo data
31	// Deployment configuration is loaded separately after migration completes.
32	//
33	// Version Tracking:
34	// - New installations: Schema version set in system_setting immediately
35	// - Existing v0.22+ installations: Schema version tracked in system_setting
36	// - Pre-v0.22 installations: Must upgrade to v0.25.x first (migration_history → system_setting migration)
37	//
38	// Migration Files:
39	// - Location: store/migration/{driver}/{version}/NN__description.sql
40	// - Naming: NN is zero-padded patch number, description is human-readable
41	// - Ordering: Files sorted lexicographically and applied in order
42	// - LATEST.sql: Full schema for new installations (faster than incremental migrations)
43	
44	//go:embed migration
45	var migrationFS embed.FS
46	
47	//go:embed seed
48	var seedFS embed.FS
49	
50	const (
51		// MigrateFileNameSplit is the split character between the patch version and the description in the migration file name.
52		// For example, "1__create_table.sql".
53		MigrateFileNameSplit = "__"
54		// LatestSchemaFileName is the name of the latest schema file.
55		// This file is used to initialize fresh installations with the current schema.
56		LatestSchemaFileName = "LATEST.sql"
57	
58		// defaultSchemaVersion is used when schema version is empty or not set.
59		// This handles edge cases for old installations without version tracking.
60		defaultSchemaVersion = "0.0.0"
61	)
62	
63	// getSchemaVersionOrDefault returns the schema version or default if empty.
64	// This ensures safe version comparisons and handles old installations.
65	func getSchemaVersionOrDefault(schemaVersion string) string {
66		if schemaVersion == "" {
67			return defaultSchemaVersion
68		}
69		return schemaVersion
70	}
71	
72	// isVersionEmpty checks if the schema version is empty or the default value.
73	func isVersionEmpty(schemaVersion string) bool {
74		return schemaVersion == "" || schemaVersion == defaultSchemaVersion
75	}
76	
77	// shouldApplyMigration determines if a migration file should be applied.
78	// It checks if the file's version is between the current DB version and target version.
79	func shouldApplyMigration(fileVersion, currentDBVersion, targetVersion string) bool {
80		currentDBVersionSafe := getSchemaVersionOrDefault(currentDBVersion)
81		return version.IsVersionGreaterThan(fileVersion, currentDBVersionSafe) &&
82			version.IsVersionGreaterOrEqualThan(targetVersion, fileVersion)
83	}
84	
85	// validateMigrationFileName checks if a migration file follows the expected naming convention.
86	// Expected format: "NN__description.sql" where NN is a zero-padded number.
87	func validateMigrationFileName(filename string) error {
88		parts := strings.SplitN(filename, MigrateFileNameSplit, 2)
89		if len(parts) < 2 {
90			return errors.Errorf("invalid migration filename format (missing %s): %s", MigrateFileNameSplit, filename)
91		}
92		if _, err := strconv.Atoi(parts[0]); err != nil {
93			return errors.Errorf("migration filename must start with a number: %s", filename)
94		}
95		return nil
96	}

98	// Migrate migrates the database schema to the latest version.
99	// It checks the current schema version and applies any necessary migrations.
100	// It also seeds the database with initial data if in demo mode.
101	func (s *Store) Migrate(ctx context.Context) error {
102		if err := s.preMigrate(ctx); err != nil {
103			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to pre-migrate")
104		}
105	
106		instanceBasicSetting, err := s.GetInstanceBasicSetting(ctx)
107		if err != nil {
108			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get instance basic setting")
109		}
110		currentSchemaVersion, err := s.GetCurrentSchemaVersion()
111		if err != nil {
112			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get current schema version")
113		}
114		// Check for downgrade (but skip if schema version is empty - that means fresh/old installation)
115		if !isVersionEmpty(instanceBasicSetting.SchemaVersion) && version.IsVersionGreaterThan(instanceBasicSetting.SchemaVersion, currentSchemaVersion) {
116			slog.Error("cannot downgrade schema version",
117				slog.String("databaseVersion", instanceBasicSetting.SchemaVersion),
118				slog.String("currentVersion", currentSchemaVersion),
119			)
120			return errors.Errorf("cannot downgrade schema version from %s to %s", instanceBasicSetting.SchemaVersion, currentSchemaVersion)
121		}
122		// Apply migrations if needed.
123		if isVersionEmpty(instanceBasicSetting.SchemaVersion) || version.IsVersionGreaterThan(currentSchemaVersion, instanceBasicSetting.SchemaVersion) {
124			if err := s.applyMigrations(ctx, instanceBasicSetting.SchemaVersion, currentSchemaVersion); err != nil {
125				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to apply migrations")
126			}
127		}
128	
129		if s.profile.Demo {
130			// In demo mode, we should seed the database.
131			if err := s.seed(ctx); err != nil {
132				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to seed")
133			}
134		}
135		return nil
136	}

138	// applyMigrations applies all necessary migration files between current and target schema versions.
139	// It runs all migrations in a single transaction for atomicity.
140	func (s *Store) applyMigrations(ctx context.Context, currentSchemaVersion, targetSchemaVersion string) error {
141		filePaths, err := fs.Glob(migrationFS, fmt.Sprintf("%s*/*.sql", s.getMigrationBasePath()))
142		if err != nil {
143			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read migration files")
144		}
145		slices.Sort(filePaths)
146	
147		// Start a transaction to apply migrations atomically
148		tx, err := s.driver.GetDB().Begin()
149		if err != nil {
150			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to start transaction")
151		}
152		defer tx.Rollback()
153	
154		// Use safe version for comparison (handles empty version case)
155		schemaVersionForComparison := getSchemaVersionOrDefault(currentSchemaVersion)
156		if isVersionEmpty(currentSchemaVersion) {
157			slog.Warn("schema version is empty, treating as default for migration comparison",
158				slog.String("defaultVersion", defaultSchemaVersion))
159		}
160	
161		slog.Info("start migration",
162			slog.String("currentSchemaVersion", schemaVersionForComparison),
163			slog.String("targetSchemaVersion", targetSchemaVersion))
164	
165		migrationsApplied := 0
166		for _, filePath := range filePaths {
167			fileSchemaVersion, err := s.getSchemaVersionOfMigrateScript(filePath)
168			if err != nil {
169				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get schema version of migrate script")
170			}
171	
172			if shouldApplyMigration(fileSchemaVersion, currentSchemaVersion, targetSchemaVersion) {
173				// Validate migration filename before applying
174				filename := filepath.Base(filePath)

177				}
178	
179				slog.Info("applying migration",

183				bytes, err := migrationFS.ReadFile(filePath)

210	// preMigrate checks if the database is initialized and applies the latest schema if not.
211	func (s *Store) preMigrate(ctx context.Context) error {
212		initialized, err := s.driver.IsInitialized(ctx)
213		if err != nil {
214			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to check if database is initialized")
215		}
216	
217		if !initialized {
218			filePath := s.getMigrationBasePath() + LatestSchemaFileName
219			bytes, err := migrationFS.ReadFile(filePath)
220			if err != nil {
221				return errors.Errorf("failed to read latest schema file: %s", err)
222			}
223			// Start a transaction to apply the latest schema.
224			tx, err := s.driver.GetDB().Begin()
225			if err != nil {
226				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to start transaction")
227			}
228			defer tx.Rollback()
229			slog.Info("initializing new database with latest schema", slog.String("file", filePath))
230			if err := s.execute(ctx, tx, string(bytes)); err != nil {
231				return errors.Errorf("failed to execute SQL file %s, err %s", filePath, err)

262	// seed seeds the database with initial data.
263	// It reads all seed files from the embedded filesystem and executes them in order.
264	// This is only supported for SQLite databases and is used in demo mode.
265	func (s *Store) seed(ctx context.Context) error {
266		// Only seed for SQLite - other databases should use production data
267		if s.profile.Driver != "sqlite" {
268			slog.Warn("seed is only supported for SQLite, skipping for other databases")
269			return nil
270		}
271	
272		filenames, err := fs.Glob(seedFS, fmt.Sprintf("%s*.sql", s.getSeedBasePath()))
273		if err != nil {
274			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read seed files")
275		}
276	
277		// Sort seed files by name. This is important to ensure that seed files are applied in order.
278		slices.Sort(filenames)
279		// Start a transaction to apply the seed files.
280		tx, err := s.driver.GetDB().Begin()
281		if err != nil {
282			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to start transaction")
283		}
284		defer tx.Rollback()
285		// Loop over all seed files and execute them in order.
286		for _, filename := range filenames {
287			bytes, err := seedFS.ReadFile(filename)
288			if err != nil {
289				return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to read seed file, filename=%s", filename)
290			}
291			if err := s.execute(ctx, tx, string(bytes)); err != nil {
292				return errors.Wrapf(err, "seed error: %s", filename)
293			}
294		}
295		return tx.Commit()
296	}

298	// GetCurrentSchemaVersion returns the latest schema version available for the configured database driver.
299	func (s *Store) GetCurrentSchemaVersion() (string, error) {
300		filePaths, err := fs.Glob(migrationFS, fmt.Sprintf("%s*/*.sql", s.getMigrationBasePath()))
301		if err != nil {
302			return "", errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read migration files")
303		}
304		if len(filePaths) == 0 {
305			return defaultSchemaVersion, nil
306		}
307	
308		currentSchemaVersion := defaultSchemaVersion
309		for _, filePath := range filePaths {
310			fileSchemaVersion, err := s.getSchemaVersionOfMigrateScript(filePath)
311			if err != nil {
312				return "", errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get schema version of migrate script")
313			}
314			if version.IsVersionGreaterThan(fileSchemaVersion, currentSchemaVersion) {
315				currentSchemaVersion = fileSchemaVersion
316			}
317		}
318		return currentSchemaVersion, nil
319	}

321	// getSchemaVersionOfMigrateScript extracts the schema version from the migration script file path.
322	// It returns the schema version in the format "major.minor.patch".
323	// If the file is the latest schema file, it returns the current schema version.
324	func (s *Store) getSchemaVersionOfMigrateScript(filePath string) (string, error) {
325		// If the file is the latest schema file, return the current schema version.
326		if strings.HasSuffix(filePath, LatestSchemaFileName) {
327			return s.GetCurrentSchemaVersion()
328		}
329	
330		normalizedPath := filepath.ToSlash(filePath)
331		elements := strings.Split(normalizedPath, "/")
332		if len(elements) < 2 {
333			return "", errors.Errorf("invalid file path: %s", filePath)
334		}
335		minorVersion := elements[len(elements)-2]
336		rawPatchVersion := strings.Split(elements[len(elements)-1], MigrateFileNameSplit)[0]
337		patchVersion, err := strconv.Atoi(rawPatchVersion)
338		if err != nil {
339			return "", errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to convert patch version to int: %s", rawPatchVersion)
340		}
341		return fmt.Sprintf("%s.%d", minorVersion, patchVersion+1), nil
342	}

24	func (s *APIV1Service) doSignIn(ctx context.Context, user *store.User) (string, time.Time, error) {
25		// Generate refresh token
26		tokenID := util.GenUUID()
27		refreshToken, refreshExpiresAt, err := auth.GenerateRefreshToken(user.ID, tokenID, []byte(s.Secret))
28		if err != nil {
29			return "", time.Time{}, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate refresh token: %v", err)
30		}
31	
32		// Store refresh token metadata
33		clientInfo := s.extractClientInfo(ctx)
34		refreshTokenRecord := &storepb.RefreshTokensUserSetting_RefreshToken{
35			TokenId:    tokenID,
36			ExpiresAt:  timestamppb.New(refreshExpiresAt),
37			CreatedAt:  timestamppb.Now(),
38			ClientInfo: clientInfo,
39		}
40		if err := s.Store.AddUserRefreshToken(ctx, user.ID, refreshTokenRecord); err != nil {
41			slog.Error("failed to store refresh token", "error", err)
42		}
43	
44		// Set refresh token cookie
45		refreshCookie := s.buildRefreshTokenCookie(ctx, refreshToken, refreshExpiresAt)
46		if err := SetResponseHeader(ctx, "Set-Cookie", refreshCookie); err != nil {
47			return "", time.Time{}, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to set refresh token cookie: %v", err)
48		}
49	
50		// Generate access token
51		accessToken, accessExpiresAt, err := auth.GenerateAccessTokenV2(
52			user.ID,
53			user.Username,
54			string(user.Role),
55			string(user.RowStatus),
56			[]byte(s.Secret),
57		)
58		if err != nil {
59			return "", time.Time{}, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate access token: %v", err)
60		}
61	
62		return accessToken, accessExpiresAt, nil
63	}

65	// SignOut terminates the user's authentication.
66	// Revokes the refresh token and clears the authentication cookie.
67	//
68	// Authentication: Required (access token).
69	// Returns: Empty response on success.
70	func (s *APIV1Service) SignOut(ctx context.Context, _ *v1pb.SignOutRequest) (*emptypb.Empty, error) {
71		// Get user from access token claims
72		claims := auth.GetUserClaims(ctx)
73		if claims != nil {
74			// Revoke refresh token if we can identify it
75			refreshToken := ""
76			if md, ok := metadata.FromIncomingContext(ctx); ok {
77				if cookies := md.Get("cookie"); len(cookies) > 0 {
78					refreshToken = auth.ExtractRefreshTokenFromCookie(cookies[0])
79				}
80			}
81			if refreshToken != "" {
82				refreshClaims, err := auth.ParseRefreshToken(refreshToken, []byte(s.Secret))
83				if err == nil {
84					// Remove refresh token from user_setting by token_id
85					_ = s.Store.RemoveUserRefreshToken(ctx, claims.UserID, refreshClaims.TokenID)
86				}
87			}
88		}

90		// Clear refresh token cookie
91		if err := s.clearAuthCookies(ctx); err != nil {
92			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to clear auth cookies, error: %v", err)
93		}

97	// RefreshToken exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token.
98	//
99	// This endpoint implements refresh token rotation with sliding window sessions:
100	// 1. Extracts the refresh token from the HttpOnly cookie (memos_refresh)
101	// 2. Validates the refresh token against the database (checking expiry and revocation)
102	// 3. Rotates the refresh token: generates a new one with fresh 30-day expiry
103	// 4. Generates a new short-lived access token (15 minutes)
104	// 5. Sets the new refresh token as HttpOnly cookie
105	// 6. Returns the new access token and its expiry time
106	//
107	// Token rotation provides:
108	// - Sliding window sessions: active users stay logged in indefinitely
109	// - Better security: stolen refresh tokens become invalid after legitimate refresh
110	//
111	// Authentication: Requires valid refresh token in cookie (public endpoint)
112	// Returns: New access token and expiry timestamp.
113	func (s *APIV1Service) RefreshToken(ctx context.Context, _ *v1pb.RefreshTokenRequest) (*v1pb.RefreshTokenResponse, error) {
114		// Extract refresh token from cookie
115		refreshToken := ""
116		if md, ok := metadata.FromIncomingContext(ctx); ok {
117			if cookies := md.Get("cookie"); len(cookies) > 0 {
118				refreshToken = auth.ExtractRefreshTokenFromCookie(cookies[0])
119			}
120		}
121	
122		if refreshToken == "" {
123			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "refresh token not found")
124		}
125	
126		// Validate refresh token and get old token ID for rotation
127		authenticator := auth.NewAuthenticator(s.Store, s.Secret)
128		user, oldTokenID, err := authenticator.AuthenticateByRefreshToken(ctx, refreshToken)
129		if err != nil {
130			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "invalid refresh token: %v", err)
131		}
132	
133		// --- Refresh Token Rotation ---
134		// Generate new refresh token with fresh 30-day expiry (sliding window)
135		newTokenID := util.GenUUID()
136		newRefreshToken, newRefreshExpiresAt, err := auth.GenerateRefreshToken(user.ID, newTokenID, []byte(s.Secret))
137		if err != nil {
138			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate refresh token: %v", err)
139		}
140	
141		// Store new refresh token (add before remove to handle race conditions)
142		clientInfo := s.extractClientInfo(ctx)
143		newRefreshTokenRecord := &storepb.RefreshTokensUserSetting_RefreshToken{
144			TokenId:    newTokenID,
145			ExpiresAt:  timestamppb.New(newRefreshExpiresAt),
146			CreatedAt:  timestamppb.Now(),
147			ClientInfo: clientInfo,
148		}
149		if err := s.Store.AddUserRefreshToken(ctx, user.ID, newRefreshTokenRecord); err != nil {
150			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to store refresh token: %v", err)
151		}
152	
153		// Remove old refresh token
154		if err := s.Store.RemoveUserRefreshToken(ctx, user.ID, oldTokenID); err != nil {
155			// Log but don't fail - old token will expire naturally
156			slog.Warn("failed to remove old refresh token", "error", err, "userID", user.ID, "tokenID", oldTokenID)
157		}
158	
159		// Set new refresh token cookie
160		newRefreshCookie := s.buildRefreshTokenCookie(ctx, newRefreshToken, newRefreshExpiresAt)
161		if err := SetResponseHeader(ctx, "Set-Cookie", newRefreshCookie); err != nil {
162			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to set refresh token cookie: %v", err)
163		}
164		// --- End Rotation ---
165	
166		// Generate new access token
167		accessToken, expiresAt, err := auth.GenerateAccessTokenV2(
168			user.ID,
169			user.Username,
170			string(user.Role),
171			string(user.RowStatus),
172			[]byte(s.Secret),
173		)
174		if err != nil {
175			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate access token: %v", err)
176		}
177	
178		return &v1pb.RefreshTokenResponse{
179			AccessToken: accessToken,
180			ExpiresAt:   timestamppb.New(expiresAt),
181		}, nil
182	}

194	func isSecureRequest(ctx context.Context) bool {
195		md, ok := metadata.FromIncomingContext(ctx)
196		if !ok {
197			return false
198		}
199	
200		for _, value := range md.Get("x-forwarded-proto") {
201			for _, proto := range strings.Split(value, ",") {
202				if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(proto), "https") {
203					return true
204				}
205			}
206		}
207	
208		for _, value := range md.Get("forwarded") {
209			lowerValue := strings.ToLower(value)
210			if strings.Contains(lowerValue, "proto=https") {
211				return true
212			}
213		}
214	
215		for _, value := range md.Get("origin") {
216			if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value)), "https://") {
217				return true
218			}
219		}
220	
221		return false
222	}

224	func (*APIV1Service) buildRefreshTokenCookie(ctx context.Context, refreshToken string, expireTime time.Time) string {
225		attrs := []string{
226			fmt.Sprintf("%s=%s", auth.RefreshTokenCookieName, refreshToken),
227			"Path=/",
228			"HttpOnly",
229		}
230		if expireTime.IsZero() {
231			attrs = append(attrs, "Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT")
232		} else {
233			// RFC 6265 requires cookie expiration dates to use GMT timezone
234			// Convert to UTC and format with explicit "GMT" to ensure browser compatibility
235			attrs = append(attrs, "Expires="+expireTime.UTC().Format("Mon, 02 Jan 2006 15:04:05 GMT"))
236		}
237	
238		if isSecureRequest(ctx) {
239			attrs = append(attrs, "SameSite=Lax", "Secure")
240		} else {
241			attrs = append(attrs, "SameSite=Lax")
242		}
243		return strings.Join(attrs, "; ")
244	}

283		if md, ok := metadata.FromIncomingContext(ctx); ok {

295			} else if realIP := md.Get("x-real-ip"); len(realIP) > 0 {
296				clientInfo.IpAddress = realIP[0]

298		}
299	
300		return clientInfo
301	}

311	// consider using a dedicated user agent parsing library.

359				if versionEnd == -1 {

362				if versionEnd != -1 {
363					version := userAgent[versionStart : versionStart+versionEnd]
364					clientInfo.Os = "Android " + version

24	func (s *APIV1Service) GetCurrentUser(ctx context.Context, _ *v1pb.GetCurrentUserRequest) (*v1pb.GetCurrentUserResponse, error) {
25		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
26		if err != nil {
27			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "failed to get current user: %v", err)
28		}
29		if user == nil {
30			// Clear auth cookies
31			if err := s.clearAuthCookies(ctx); err != nil {
32				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to clear auth cookies: %v", err)
33			}
34			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not found")
35		}
36	
37		return &v1pb.GetCurrentUserResponse{
38			User: convertUserFromStore(user, user),

42	// SignIn authenticates a user with credentials and returns tokens.
43	// On success, returns an access token and sets a refresh token cookie.
44	//
45	// Supports two authentication methods:
46	// 1. Password-based authentication (username + password).
47	// 2. SSO authentication (OAuth2 authorization code).
48	//
49	// Authentication: Not required (public endpoint).
50	// Returns: User info, access token, and token expiry.
51	func (s *APIV1Service) SignIn(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.SignInRequest) (*v1pb.SignInResponse, error) {
52		var existingUser *store.User
53	
54		// Authentication Method 1: Password-based authentication
55		if passwordCredentials := request.GetPasswordCredentials(); passwordCredentials != nil {
56			user, err := s.Store.GetUser(ctx, &store.FindUser{
57				Username: &passwordCredentials.Username,
58			})
59			if err != nil {
60				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user, error: %v", err)
61			}
62			if user == nil {
63				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, unmatchedUsernameAndPasswordError)
64			}
65			// Compare the stored hashed password, with the hashed version of the password that was received.
66			if err := bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword([]byte(user.PasswordHash), []byte(passwordCredentials.Password)); err != nil {
67				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, unmatchedUsernameAndPasswordError)
68			}
69			instanceGeneralSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceGeneralSetting(ctx)
70			if err != nil {
71				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get instance general setting, error: %v", err)
72			}
73			// Check if the password auth in is allowed.
74			if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowPasswordAuth && user.Role == store.RoleUser {
75				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "password signin is not allowed")
76			}
77			existingUser = user
78		} else if ssoCredentials := request.GetSsoCredentials(); ssoCredentials != nil {
79			// Authentication Method 2: SSO (OAuth2) authentication
80			identityProvider, userInfo, err := s.resolveSSOIdentity(ctx, ssoCredentials.IdpName, ssoCredentials.Code, ssoCredentials.RedirectUri, ssoCredentials.CodeVerifier)
81			if err != nil {
82				return nil, err
83			}
84			user, err := s.resolveSSOUser(ctx, nil, identityProvider, userInfo)
85			if err != nil {
86				return nil, err
87			}
88			existingUser = user
89		}
90	
91		if existingUser == nil {
92			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid credentials")
93		}
94		if existingUser.RowStatus == store.Archived {
95			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "user has been archived with username %s", existingUser.Username)
96		}
97	
98		accessToken, accessExpiresAt, err := s.doSignIn(ctx, existingUser)
99		if err != nil {
100			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to sign in: %v", err)
101		}
102	
103		return &v1pb.SignInResponse{
104			User:                 convertUserFromStore(existingUser, existingUser),
105			AccessToken:          accessToken,
106			AccessTokenExpiresAt: timestamppb.New(accessExpiresAt),
107		}, nil
108	}

111	// linkage record (and a new local user if necessary) when first login is allowed.
112	//
113	// Lookup goes through the user_identity table so that userInfo.Identifier is never used
114	// as the local username key. On the miss path, a local user is created with a
115	// UUID-based local username (see deriveSSOUsername) and the (provider, extern_uid)
116	// linkage is inserted in the same flow. When currentUser is provided by a caller
117	// outside AuthService.SignIn, the lookup miss path binds the external identity to
118	// that existing user instead. If the linkage insert loses a race on the unique
119	// (provider, extern_uid) constraint, the winning linkage's user is loaded and
120	// checked against the current user.

24	func (s *APIV1Service) doSignIn(ctx context.Context, user *store.User) (string, time.Time, error) {
25		// Generate refresh token
26		tokenID := util.GenUUID()
27		refreshToken, refreshExpiresAt, err := auth.GenerateRefreshToken(user.ID, tokenID, []byte(s.Secret))
28		if err != nil {
29			return "", time.Time{}, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate refresh token: %v", err)
30		}
31	
32		// Store refresh token metadata
33		clientInfo := s.extractClientInfo(ctx)
34		refreshTokenRecord := &storepb.RefreshTokensUserSetting_RefreshToken{
35			TokenId:    tokenID,
36			ExpiresAt:  timestamppb.New(refreshExpiresAt),
37			CreatedAt:  timestamppb.Now(),
38			ClientInfo: clientInfo,
39		}
40		if err := s.Store.AddUserRefreshToken(ctx, user.ID, refreshTokenRecord); err != nil {
41			slog.Error("failed to store refresh token", "error", err)
42		}
43	
44		// Set refresh token cookie
45		refreshCookie := s.buildRefreshTokenCookie(ctx, refreshToken, refreshExpiresAt)
46		if err := SetResponseHeader(ctx, "Set-Cookie", refreshCookie); err != nil {
47			return "", time.Time{}, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to set refresh token cookie: %v", err)
48		}
49	
50		// Generate access token
51		accessToken, accessExpiresAt, err := auth.GenerateAccessTokenV2(
52			user.ID,
53			user.Username,
54			string(user.Role),
55			string(user.RowStatus),
56			[]byte(s.Secret),
57		)
58		if err != nil {
59			return "", time.Time{}, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate access token: %v", err)
60		}
61	
62		return accessToken, accessExpiresAt, nil
63	}

65	// SignOut terminates the user's authentication.
66	// Revokes the refresh token and clears the authentication cookie.
67	//
68	// Authentication: Required (access token).
69	// Returns: Empty response on success.
70	func (s *APIV1Service) SignOut(ctx context.Context, _ *v1pb.SignOutRequest) (*emptypb.Empty, error) {
71		// Get user from access token claims
72		claims := auth.GetUserClaims(ctx)
73		if claims != nil {
74			// Revoke refresh token if we can identify it
75			refreshToken := ""
76			if md, ok := metadata.FromIncomingContext(ctx); ok {
77				if cookies := md.Get("cookie"); len(cookies) > 0 {
78					refreshToken = auth.ExtractRefreshTokenFromCookie(cookies[0])
79				}
80			}
81			if refreshToken != "" {
82				refreshClaims, err := auth.ParseRefreshToken(refreshToken, []byte(s.Secret))
83				if err == nil {
84					// Remove refresh token from user_setting by token_id
85					_ = s.Store.RemoveUserRefreshToken(ctx, claims.UserID, refreshClaims.TokenID)
86				}
87			}
88		}
89	
90		// Clear refresh token cookie
91		if err := s.clearAuthCookies(ctx); err != nil {
92			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to clear auth cookies, error: %v", err)
93		}
94		return &emptypb.Empty{}, nil
95	}

97	// RefreshToken exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token.
98	//
99	// This endpoint implements refresh token rotation with sliding window sessions:
100	// 1. Extracts the refresh token from the HttpOnly cookie (memos_refresh)
101	// 2. Validates the refresh token against the database (checking expiry and revocation)
102	// 3. Rotates the refresh token: generates a new one with fresh 30-day expiry
103	// 4. Generates a new short-lived access token (15 minutes)
104	// 5. Sets the new refresh token as HttpOnly cookie
105	// 6. Returns the new access token and its expiry time
106	//
107	// Token rotation provides:
108	// - Sliding window sessions: active users stay logged in indefinitely
109	// - Better security: stolen refresh tokens become invalid after legitimate refresh
110	//
111	// Authentication: Requires valid refresh token in cookie (public endpoint)
112	// Returns: New access token and expiry timestamp.
113	func (s *APIV1Service) RefreshToken(ctx context.Context, _ *v1pb.RefreshTokenRequest) (*v1pb.RefreshTokenResponse, error) {
114		// Extract refresh token from cookie
115		refreshToken := ""
116		if md, ok := metadata.FromIncomingContext(ctx); ok {
117			if cookies := md.Get("cookie"); len(cookies) > 0 {
118				refreshToken = auth.ExtractRefreshTokenFromCookie(cookies[0])
119			}
120		}
121	
122		if refreshToken == "" {
123			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "refresh token not found")
124		}
125	
126		// Validate refresh token and get old token ID for rotation
127		authenticator := auth.NewAuthenticator(s.Store, s.Secret)
128		user, oldTokenID, err := authenticator.AuthenticateByRefreshToken(ctx, refreshToken)
129		if err != nil {
130			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "invalid refresh token: %v", err)
131		}
132	
133		// --- Refresh Token Rotation ---
134		// Generate new refresh token with fresh 30-day expiry (sliding window)
135		newTokenID := util.GenUUID()
136		newRefreshToken, newRefreshExpiresAt, err := auth.GenerateRefreshToken(user.ID, newTokenID, []byte(s.Secret))
137		if err != nil {
138			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate refresh token: %v", err)
139		}
140	
141		// Store new refresh token (add before remove to handle race conditions)
142		clientInfo := s.extractClientInfo(ctx)
143		newRefreshTokenRecord := &storepb.RefreshTokensUserSetting_RefreshToken{
144			TokenId:    newTokenID,
145			ExpiresAt:  timestamppb.New(newRefreshExpiresAt),
146			CreatedAt:  timestamppb.Now(),
147			ClientInfo: clientInfo,
148		}
149		if err := s.Store.AddUserRefreshToken(ctx, user.ID, newRefreshTokenRecord); err != nil {
150			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to store refresh token: %v", err)
151		}
152	
153		// Remove old refresh token
154		if err := s.Store.RemoveUserRefreshToken(ctx, user.ID, oldTokenID); err != nil {
155			// Log but don't fail - old token will expire naturally
156			slog.Warn("failed to remove old refresh token", "error", err, "userID", user.ID, "tokenID", oldTokenID)
157		}
158	
159		// Set new refresh token cookie
160		newRefreshCookie := s.buildRefreshTokenCookie(ctx, newRefreshToken, newRefreshExpiresAt)
161		if err := SetResponseHeader(ctx, "Set-Cookie", newRefreshCookie); err != nil {
162			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to set refresh token cookie: %v", err)
163		}
164		// --- End Rotation ---
165	
166		// Generate new access token
167		accessToken, expiresAt, err := auth.GenerateAccessTokenV2(
168			user.ID,
169			user.Username,
170			string(user.Role),
171			string(user.RowStatus),
172			[]byte(s.Secret),
173		)
174		if err != nil {
175			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate access token: %v", err)
176		}
177	
178		return &v1pb.RefreshTokenResponse{
179			AccessToken: accessToken,
180			ExpiresAt:   timestamppb.New(expiresAt),
181		}, nil
182	}

194	func isSecureRequest(ctx context.Context) bool {
195		md, ok := metadata.FromIncomingContext(ctx)
196		if !ok {

198		}
199	
200		for _, value := range md.Get("x-forwarded-proto") {
201			for _, proto := range strings.Split(value, ",") {
202				if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(proto), "https") {
203					return true
204				}
205			}
206		}
207	
208		for _, value := range md.Get("forwarded") {
209			lowerValue := strings.ToLower(value)
210			if strings.Contains(lowerValue, "proto=https") {
211				return true
212			}
213		}
214	
215		for _, value := range md.Get("origin") {
216			if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value)), "https://") {
217				return true
218			}
219		}
220	
221		return false
222	}

224	func (*APIV1Service) buildRefreshTokenCookie(ctx context.Context, refreshToken string, expireTime time.Time) string {
225		attrs := []string{
226			fmt.Sprintf("%s=%s", auth.RefreshTokenCookieName, refreshToken),
227			"Path=/",
228			"HttpOnly",
229		}
230		if expireTime.IsZero() {
231			attrs = append(attrs, "Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT")
232		} else {
233			// RFC 6265 requires cookie expiration dates to use GMT timezone
234			// Convert to UTC and format with explicit "GMT" to ensure browser compatibility
235			attrs = append(attrs, "Expires="+expireTime.UTC().Format("Mon, 02 Jan 2006 15:04:05 GMT"))
236		}
237	
238		if isSecureRequest(ctx) {
239			attrs = append(attrs, "SameSite=Lax", "Secure")
240		} else {
241			attrs = append(attrs, "SameSite=Lax")
242		}
243		return strings.Join(attrs, "; ")
244	}

q29. **/bench/repo/web/src/connect.ts (authInterceptor at line 156); access tokens and refresh tokens; /bench/repo/server/auth**

Frontend API requests are authenticated through the `authInterceptor` defined in `/bench/repo/web/src/connect.ts` (line 156). The interceptor manages two token kinds:
1. **Access tokens** - short-lived JWT tokens (15 minutes) sent in the Authorization header
2. **Refresh tokens** - stored as HttpOnly cookies, used to obtain new access tokens

These tokens are validated by the backend `auth` package (`/bench/repo/server/auth`), specifically through the `Authenticator` struct (in `/bench/repo/server/auth/authenticator.go`), which provides stateless validation for access tokens and handles refresh token verification.
